name: AlmasB/FXGL
description: A Java/JavaFX/Kotlin 2D game development framework with a clean API, Entity-Component architecture, animations, and particle systems. Supports Windows, Mac, Linux, Android, iOS, and web.
score_rationale: 4.8k stars, MIT, actively maintained Java/Kotlin engine offering a modern alternative to LibGDX for JVM developers.
summary: JavaFX-based 2D engine with ECS and modern API for JVM games
